declined_domains.reason: the motor phase currents are judged as claims against the driver's stated rating; a conductor capacity basis has not been sourced for this board

device figures live in components/parameters.json with per-figure document citations; the figures with no stated allowance at all (the debug pin's negative injection) are enumerated in the claim policy instead
this board routes no differential pair; every net on it is single-ended and there is no pair impedance to hold

the adopted copper came from KiCadRoutingTools 0.21.5 with grid_router 0.21.4 under KiCad 10.0.5, and this tree resolves 0.22.0, 0.22.0 and 10.0.6; a study run now would measure a different tool than the one that drew this board, which the gate itself refuses, and the search's input board was never committed so the distribution that produced this copper cannot be resampled. Re-running the declared search from the current sources refuses all 12 attempts on THERMAL.BOARD_RISE, so no acceptable candidate exists to sample until the board rise meets its budget

no lifecycle source has been frozen for this board; the committed JLCPCB library responses carry stock and an on-sale flag, which the toolkit's own freeze distinguishes from a lifecycle statement, and establishing a status is a reviewer's act on evidence nobody has retrieved yet - tracked as the jlcpcb-lifecycle-snapshot dependency
the motor supply is judged as a claim over the declared decoupling and source impedance; no rail is poured as a plane whose IR drop a solve would decide
no interface on this board declares a return-path requirement today
no requirement register is authored yet; every claim's requirement cites the brief or a frozen document directly, and the register lands with a later revision

permitted.because: the driver's junction-to-ambient path on THIS board's copper is a thermal-solve quantity; the datasheet figure is quoted on its own test board, and the claim records the factor by which this board may be worse before the limit is reached

the debug bridge's datasheet states no negative-injection allowance for the pin at all; only a vendor figure or a bench characterisation closes it, and the series element bounds what the pin can see meanwhile

external_dependencies.statement: the assembled board's temperature rise above ambient at full phase current, measured at the driver and the sense resistors
JLCPCB's own assembly preview shows every part at its intended position and rotation
a lifecycle and stock snapshot for every fitted part, frozen from the fabricator and reviewed into an established status, so a discontinued part is a gate failure rather than a discovery
